# OSHA 10-Hour General Industry Outreach Training Online

> OSHA 10-Hour General Industry Outreach Training: a self-paced online course from $89.99. 100% online, certificate on completion, team pricing.

Self-paced online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com), part of Industrial Certified Training, LLC (https://ictraining.us/). Courses are 100% online and work on any device, with a certificate of completion as soon as the final exam is passed. Team pricing applies from 2 to 1,000 seats. Phone: 1-866-429-6742.

- [OSHA 10-Hour General Industry Outreach Training with DOL Card](https://osha-10-general-industry.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-435): $89.99 per person, 10 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 60 months.
